mappings.meaning: Four WORD bounds used to gate the S3 boss initializer on camera location.
Delegate the CNZ pre-battle actor update to the shared arena/music readiness protocol.
Install the steady CNZ battle update after the shared readiness callback completes.
Return from callback installation or one of the existing early-exit branches in the CNZ battle logic.
Dispatch the current CNZ boss routine, then update magnet/player interaction, hits and sprite collision drawing.
Eight relative WORD offsets for the CNZ boss state dispatcher.
Initialize the active battle actor and its coordinated ship, dropped core and magnets.
Continue battle initialization with the core and repeated magnet child records.
Move and bob during the initial timer before entering pursuit.
Reinitialize bobbing when returning from core retrieval, then enter timed pursuit.
Select the timed horizontal player-following state.
Choose horizontal pursuit direction toward the nearer player outside the original dead zone.
Commit the already selected pursuit velocity before the shared motion tail.
Shared movement/timer tail of horizontal pursuit.
End pursuit and signal the attached core to drop.
Keep bobbing while the dropped core has not reported settling.
Switch from drop waiting to alignment over the settled core.
Bob and move the boss one pixel toward the settled core X coordinate.
Move left by one pixel while horizontally aligning with the core.
Start the timed magnet sequence after reaching the core X coordinate.
Run the timer callback chain while the magnet sequence is active.
Enable the boss attraction field and spawn its two electric effects.
Disable attraction and start the release delay.
Leave the timed magnet chain and begin moving down toward the core.
Lower the boss toward twenty pixels above the core.
Signal core reattachment and start ascent after the lowering threshold.
Raise the boss one pixel per update toward its original Y.
Restore the exact saved hover height before restarting the attack cycle.
Start S3 defeat breakup and music fade with an explicit delay.
Start the S3 post-defeat camera extension.
Wait for S3 camera-limit extension to finish, then restore both players and advance bounds.

Shared return for the exit cannon threshold and allocation attempt.
Wait for S3 exit cannon occupancy before beginning the launch delay.
Inject a jump when the post-entry delay has expired and the cannon points at angle0x12.
Start level0x500 when Player1 has risen to the camera top margin.
Update the dropped core state, parent defeat response and sprite contacts.
Six relative WORD state offsets for the boss core.
